edits.old: **No personal data** appears in any element, fake or example: the accepting user is an identifier, and every fixture identifier is synthetic.
edits.new: **No personal data** appears in any element, fake or example: the accepting user is an identifier, and every fixture identifier is synthetic. The reference data and parameters are read under DP-06 and DP-07: the closed lists are referenced by identifier and version, the band policy by its identifier and version, and no parameter key or reference-data contract field is named here (Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S1-E4004-CON-20)). A consumed operation with no published name carries the placeholder and its gap (GAP-2604); its client and fake are built from the documented use, and a published name replaces the placeholder in a minor version (BR2). The acceptance element set is declared as optional elements of the one operation API-S1-001 and not as a second operation; any separate acceptance write is added later by its owner in a minor version with its rights and error set (GAP-2606). Until the owner names the field or table that holds the accepted value, accepted_at and the accepting user (GAP-2603), the acceptance is the decision record and the case move answer.
